# JNK Nutrition

> Sports nutrition and supplement retailer based in Deira, Dubai, shipping across
> the United Arab Emirates. 100% genuine products from imported and regional
> brands: whey and mass-gain protein, creatine, pre-workouts, fat burners,
> vitamins and general wellness, plus shakers and accessories.

The storefront is bilingual. English pages live at the paths below; the Arabic
translation of any page is the same path under `/ar` (for example
`/collections/creatine` → `/ar/collections/creatine`). Prices are in AED.

## Shop

- [All products](https://www.jnknutrition.com/products): the full catalogue, filterable by brand, category and price.
- [All collections](https://www.jnknutrition.com/collections): index of every category.
- [Brands](https://www.jnknutrition.com/brands): directory of every brand stocked.
- [Today's deals](https://www.jnknutrition.com/collections/today-deals): everything currently discounted.
- [Near-expiry sale](https://www.jnknutrition.com/collections/near-expiry): genuine stock close to its best-before date, heavily reduced.

## About the store

- [About JNK Nutrition](https://www.jnknutrition.com/pages/about): who we are and how we source.
- [Contact](https://www.jnknutrition.com/pages/contact): shop address, phone, WhatsApp and opening hours.
- [FAQ](https://www.jnknutrition.com/pages/faq): delivery, returns, authenticity and payment questions.
- [Wholesale](https://www.jnknutrition.com/pages/wholesale): bulk and trade enquiries.
- [News and guides](https://www.jnknutrition.com/blogs/news): articles on supplements and training.

## Notes for crawlers

- A machine-readable index of every page is at [/sitemap.xml](https://www.jnknutrition.com/sitemap.xml).
- Crawl rules are at [/robots.txt](https://www.jnknutrition.com/robots.txt). Account, cart and checkout paths are disallowed and hold no useful content.
- Product pages carry Product structured data (price, availability, brand); the
  site itself carries Organization, Store and WebSite structured data.
